summary: Verified iteration 9 video features end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_video_range_and_cms.py — HTTP Range streaming on GET /api/public/media/{id}: 200 full body + Accept-Ranges:bytes + Content-Length, 206 for 'bytes=0-99' with correct Content-Range/Content-Length, 206 suffix 'bytes=size-1000-' returns last 1000 bytes, 416 for out-of-range with Content-Range 'bytes */size', .mp4 Content-Type is video/mp4 (not video/x-m4v), ?kind=video ignored. Image regression: 200 + image content-type; ?thumb=1 200. CMS persistence: PUT /api/site/pages/home with hero.image='?kind=video' and gallery items with '?kind=video' survives round-trip via GET /api/public/pages/home; PUT /api/content/destinations/{id} with hero_image + gallery video URLs persisted (public/destinations/bali returns them intact); PATCH /api/vehicles/{id} with photos+gallery (dict format) accepts video URLs and public/fleet/{id} returns them. Frontend: public / hero-backdrop renders playing <video autoplay muted loop playsinline> (paused=false, currentTime>0 after 3s, readyState=4); home-gallery has data-kind=video tile with <video> and data-kind=image tile; clicking video tile opens [data-testid=lightbox-video] with controls; clicking image tile opens img lightbox. Destination detail /destinations/bali: dest-hero-backdrop <video> plays (paused=false, readyState=4); dest-gallery has both data-kind=video and data-kind=image tiles when hero URL and gallery URL differ. Fleet detail /fleet/veh_...: fleet-gallery-main data-kind=video contains fleet-gallery-video that autoplays (paused=false, readyState=4). CMS Halaman page builder: hero ImageField [data-testid$='-pick'] opens MediaPickerDialog with all 3 kind tabs (media-tab-all/-image/-video), video assets listed, picking video sets input URL to '/api/public/media/<id>?kind=video' and thumb [data-testid$='-thumb'] renders as VIDEO tag with data-kind=video. Landing editor /app/landing (opened via Edit): top-bar [data-testid=lp-media-open] opens MediaPickerDialog with all 3 kind tabs; Hero ImageField also has 'Pilih dari Media Library' opening picker. Note: this template lacks a Gallery block so lp-gallery-add didn't appear (template-dependent, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: routers/public.py public_media Range implementation is clean: uses _parse_range (returns None if header absent/invalid so full body served), _range_bounds returns (None,None) on out-of-bounds → correct 416 with Content-Range bytes */size, and _file_chunks streams in 512 KB chunks — avoids loading whole file in memory. Nice.
services/media_store.py EXT_TYPES override guarantees .mp4 → video/mp4 (video/x-m4v only used as inverse for MIME-to-ext, never sent to browser). Confirmed via response header.

features/public/DestinationDetail.jsx gallery filter drops items whose url equals hero_image; this hides the video gallery tile if the user picks the SAME video URL for hero and gallery[0]. Consider comparing on canonical asset id (stripping query string) or leaving as-is with a UX note — currently working as expected but easy to trip over during CMS content-entry.

components/media/MediaBrowser + MediaGrid rely on data-testid='media-item-<id>' (container) and 'media-item-open-<id>' (button); MediaPickerDialog is consistent across PageBuilderSectionCard, GalleryManager, ContentFormDialog, LandingBuilder — SSOT achieved.
